purpose: Measure whether the original frozen E8 Fplus/Fminus pair, constructed in the kinetic null space at z=1100, remains matched in the same n,rho,P moment convention at z=1.0 and z=0.95.
outputs: For each z, FD/Fplus/Fminus moments n,rho,P and symmetric Fplus-vs-Fminus relative gaps.
interpretation: Diagnostic only. If z=1 gaps are not negligible, the original E8 pair must not be described as stress-energy matched at K01E start; a separately preregistered z=1 null-pair construction is then required for the self-gravity hidden-state test.
